Crewtender nutzt das KI-Modell Claude vo: Crewtender uses the AI model Claude by Anthropic for: rating tenders, fact sheets from tender documents, the search profile from the company website, reading receipts and expiry dates, bid texts.
KI-Ergebnisse sind gekennzeichnet (🤖). S: AI results are marked (🤖). They are suggestions: always check deadlines, lots, supporting documents and amounts against the original before relying on them.
The AI makes no decisions about people. Staff search, replacement suggestions, ratings and shift planning work with fixed rules; a human always makes the decision.
Keine Personalakten, Gesundheitsdaten od: Do not upload personnel files, health data or background checks. Names of contact persons in tender documents are redacted before they reach the AI.
Die Daten gehen an Anthropic in den USA: The data goes to Anthropic in the USA (standard contractual clauses) and is not used there for training. During the trial period there is a fixed AI quota per company.
Den Vertrag zur Auftragsverarbeitung les: Read the data processing agreement: you are the controller for staff, customer and applicant data; we process it on your behalf.
Beschäftigte und Bewerber informieren, w: Inform employees and applicants which data you store in Crewtender (Art. 13 GDPR).
Gibt es einen Betriebsrat, vor dem Einsa: If there is a works council, obtain its consent before using the time clock, patrol rounds, ratings and reports (§ 87(1) no. 6 BetrVG; in other countries the local employee representation).
Keine Gesundheitsangaben, Krankheitsgrün: Do not write health information, reasons for illness or criminal record data in free-text fields.
Crewtender löscht automatisch nach feste: Crewtender deletes automatically after fixed periods (e.g. clock times after 2 years). You must keep invoices and receipts for 8 to 10 years: download the archive before deleting the account.
